name: WeatherAPI.com
tagline: REST weather API for forecasts, history, astronomy, and sports
description: WeatherAPI.com is a REST weather data service offering current conditions, multi-day forecasts, historical weather, astronomy, and sports-related weather endpoints. Developers authenticate with a free API key and call JSON endpoints for location-based weather queries worldwide.

auth.details: API key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY (self-serve signup)

use_cases: get current weather for a city
get multi-day weather forecast for a location
look up historical weather for a past date
get astronomy data (sunrise, moon phase) for a location
